lines: Sahba-e-gharaz thi, shola-e-riya tha khirad ke paimane mein
couplets.en: Self-interest was the wine, and hypocrisy burned in the cup of reason.
Even the drinkers brought themselves to ruin.

lines: Ab kuchh na raha mai-khane mein
couplets.en: There is nothing left in the tavern now.
Even the drinkers brought themselves to ruin.

lines: Ab kuchh na raha mai-khane mein
couplets.en: There is nothing left in the tavern now.

lines: Tankar ke nazuk nashtar se kat jati hain gham ki zanjiren
couplets.en: A single ringing note can cut through the chains of grief.

lines: Kah do ke mohabbat raqs kare duniya ke is aatish-khane mein
couplets.en: Tell love to dance in the furnace of this world.

lines: Zinda hai zulm ke darmiyan bhi insaan ki ruh-e-azadi
couplets.en: Even under tyranny, the human spirit stays free.

lines: Sholon pe pani phir jaye, aayi hai ghata virane mein
couplets.en: Let rain sweep over the flames, for clouds have reached the wasteland.

lines: Tabinda hai iman, Shakeel, isko hi ibadat kahte hain
couplets.en: Faith still shines, Shakeel, and that is worship.

lines: Sajde ke liye kuchh farq nahin, Kaabe mein ho ya but-khane mein
couplets.en: A bowed head is the same in the Kaaba or before an idol.
